text:
cheng: Heads up — need to provision a new GPU nodepool in brazil-south1 for low-latency embeddings (customer X). Can we spec sizing and check quotas?
jamal: What workload profile? small requests or long context batch jobs?
cheng: Mostly short requests, 8-32 token embeddings, steady 200 qps avg, occasional 2k qps spikes. Latency SLO 20ms p95 for embeddings path.
rebecca: For that qps range we probably want compact nodes with A10G or A2 family. A100 seems overkill and drives cost. Brazil quotas are tight though — last time we saw limited A10G availability.
maya: Also FYI the shared subnet in that region is already at 75% IP utilization. If we spin up >40 nodes we'll hit /24 NAT egress constraints.
cheng: Good call. Thinking 6-10 nodes to start, autoscaler to 40 max for bursts. Use taint gpu=true:NoSchedule and nodeSelector for embeddings pods.
jamal: Sounds fine. I recommend spot/preemptible mix: 60% spot, 40% guaranteed. Set pod disruptionBudget and use graceful termination hooks.
rebecca: Agreed on mix. For instance types: prefer a2-highgpu-1g (A10G equivalent) if quota allows. Fallback to a2-highgpu-2g if single-sku limited.
maya: If fallback to 2g, watch pod packing to avoid wasting GPUs on single-pod-per-node patterns. Use descheduler or binpacking config.
cheng: Here's a draft nodepool config for review:
```
nodePool:
  name: bras-emb-a10g
  machineType: a2-highgpu-1g
  initialNodeCount: 6
  autoscaling:
    min: 6
    max: 40
  taints:
    - key: gpu
      value: "true"
      effect: NoSchedule
  labels:
    workload: embeddings
  preemptible: true
  spotPercentage: 60
```
jamal: Looks good. Two notes: set max surge=0 and maxUnavailable=1 for rolling updates to avoid GPU churn. Also enable graceful node draining with 5m buffer for KV cache flush.
rebecca: I'll queue quota checks with cloud support for a2 SKU and request 20 GPUs reserve. If denied, we'll automatically fall back to 2g with smaller autoscaler max.
maya: Network tasks: I'll carve a /26 out of the staging subnet for the pool to avoid touching the crowded /24. Need approval for NAT egress ips; we have 3 free NAT addresses — should be fine for initial scale.
sre-oncall: Please add monitoring alerts: Node GPU utilization, pod eviction rate, and NAT SNAT port exhaustion. Also alert on repeated preemptions >3/hr.
cheng: Will do — adding dashboards and alerting rules. Any objections to 60/40 spot mix?
jamal: No objections. Only ask: add fallback policy to spin up A100 dedicated nodes for critical customer traffic if spot eviction rate > 20% for 10m.
rebecca: We can add an emergency dedicated pool (a100-dedicated-brief) behind a routing policy. It'll cost more but keep SLO.
maya: Small networking ask: update egress firewall to allow telemetry to eu-central if metrics get forwarded there.
cheng: Cool. Action items: rebecca -> quota request + reserve 20 GPUs, maya -> carve /26 and update NAT, jamal -> create autoscaler + rollout policy, rebecca/cheng -> add fallback pool plan, sre-oncall -> alert rules. I'll file the infra ticket and tag people.
infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-6798 created: "brazil-south1 embeddings GPU pool provision" — assigned to rebecca, jamal. ETA 48h for quota reply.
rebecca: Thanks. I'll post updates here after quota check.
jamal: If quota comes back slow we can route lower-priority traffic to eu-west until provisioned.
cheng: OK thanks team :thumbsup:
